blog.summary: The longest stretch in a row that follows a rule, like sum ≤ 5: grow on the right, shrink on the left.
blog.tested_inputs: hand-picked cases (budget 0, budget above the whole sum, one number too big, equal numbers) and random arrays of up to 14 positive numbers with random budgets, plus one array of 3,000 numbers
blog.tested_against: a brute force that tries every stretch
blog.tested_extra: The walk, the longest length and the trap result come from running the code.

caption.first: Sliding window of any size: the longest run within a budget, by growing on the right and shrinking on the left.
lines: Add the new number, shrink while the rule breaks, then measure.
The trap: measure before shrinking and 2 1 3 1 4 gives 4 instead of 3.
